items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: And you take Tom Albert. Do you know him? ... Right. Tom Albert. Taking my oldest brother. He was a planet wizard. Brought in here to the city of New Orleans from Paschkee Stanton. And they played and they played all in Lafayette.

ctx.x: Oh, three boys, one girl, and your father and mother. That's right. That's right.

Six of us in the family. Six of us in the family. Well, we had two more, Eugene and another girl, but they passed as babies. They passed as babies. Twin to the guitar player. Oh, really? Yeah. He passed as a baby. Uh-huh. And my sister, other sister, she passed as a baby. Uh-huh. Now, Eugene was my twin brother's brother. And the other girl, she was, I just remember her name now, because she passed as a baby also. And therefore, well, it was just six of us right up and we are still all together, four of us is all…
Oh, yes. He used to play violin and then carnet, too. Right.
